_doc: Registry of QA checks. severity: hard = files a GitHub issue (once QA_REPORT_ONLY is off), soft = weekly summary only. born_from = the real incident that created the check (rule: every manually found defect becomes a check + a fixture, see CLAUDE.md).

web.status.born_from: Q0 baseline: any sitemap URL or internal link that is not a clean 200 (the 'unpublish never gated the site' class, 2026-09-03)
web.status.what: HTTP status != 200 for a sitemap URL, redirect chain > 2, or a broken internal link

web.console.born_from: /today Tonight/Tomorrow script dead in production since Fas 1 (2026-10-21)
web.console.what: console.error, uncaught page error or failed first-party request

web.literal.what: visible 'undefined', 'NaN', 'null', '[object Object]', 'Invalid Date', '{{' or a lone '--'

web.title-dup.what: the same <title> on more than one URL in a run

web.leak.born_from: culture essay on moreno_valley_ca that belonged to Brookings (2026-08, see CONTAMINATION_REPORT.md)
web.leak.what: another town's identity term (ai_pipeline/town_guard.py HARD_BLOCKLIST) in <main>, title, meta description or img alt

ops.scrape-liveness.born_from: GitHub cron started scrapes 4.5-9.5 h late; Cloudflare cron-dispatcher + watchdog (Kö 9 Steg 1, 2026-10-21)
ops.scrape-liveness.what: a town has had no successful scrape_runs row for 18 h

qa.tracking.born_from: QA must never count as a visitor (owner requirement 2026-10-21)
qa.tracking.what: page tried to load analytics/ads scripts although QA declined consent (they were aborted)

web.axe.born_from: Fas 6 dark mode contrast work (2026-10-21) -- contrast regressions found by eye
web.axe.what: axe WCAG A/AA violation with impact serious/critical, in light or dark, desktop or mobile (key pages)

web.axe-minor.what: axe WCAG A/AA violation with impact minor/moderate

web.empty.born_from: Broomfield /this-week empty (events table only had NWS alerts, 2026-10)

web.clientfill.born_from: /today Tonight/Tomorrow never filled on any town from Fas 1 to 2026-10-21 (:scope on template fragment; Broomfield lost the bucket script)
web.clientfill.what: client-rendered bucket still empty although the template holds events and there is no 'nothing scheduled' note

web.stale-alert.born_from: expired weather/closure alerts kept showing (Time/alerts handoff Phase 1, 2026-10-20)
web.stale-alert.what: element with data-ends in the past that is still visible (real clock and the 07:00/19:00/23:30 clock passes)

web.past-event.born_from: passed events shown under Today/Tonight (Time/alerts handoff)
web.past-event.what: event in the Tonight bucket that is over (or not today), or in Tomorrow that is not tomorrow, at the page's clock

web.extlink.born_from: Q1: external links checked weekly only (load reduction)
web.extlink.what: external link answering 4xx/5xx (401/403/429 ignored as bot walls) or unreachable
